decisions.question: 1. Popularity: how is a wrestler's and company's popularity stored?

options.title: Per region (recommended)
options.pitch: Popularity per wrestler and per company for each road area (USA regions, Japan, UK...). A star can be huge in Japan and unknown in Texas.
pros: Best single model in the genre (TEW)
Makes touring, territory map and wars meaningful
Markets already exist to build on

options.title: Global + city markets (today)
options.pitch: Keep one popularity number per person; cities keep their own market heat (S.mkt).

options.title: Hybrid: global + a few home-region boosts
options.pitch: One number, plus a bonus in up to 3 home areas.
pros: Hometown pops already partly do this

options.title: After launch (recommended)
options.pitch: Keep strength + memory now. Add the three optional fields post-launch with UI to show them.
pros: Research says add axes only with UI

options.title: During the TS port
options.pitch: Add optional family/personal/romantic fields in the new types now, unused until later.
pros: Shape fixed once, no later migration

options.title: Now, with full UI
options.pitch: Build the 3-axis model, editor support and dossier display before launch.

decisions.question: 3. Data-checking (schema) library for world packages and saves

options.title: Zod (recommended)
options.pitch: Most-used TS schema library; types are inferred from schemas.

options.title: Valibot
options.pitch: Zod-like API, tree-shakes to a few KB.

options.title: Typia
options.pitch: Generates validators from plain TS types at build time.

decisions.question: 4. Build tool for the engine package

options.title: esbuild (recommended)
options.pitch: One fast bundler for engine; app keeps its current setup.
pros: Already common in the repo's tooling
cons: No dev server features (not needed for engine)

options.title: Vite for everything
options.pitch: Move engine and app onto Vite (uses esbuild/rollup inside).
cons: Single-file dist page needs a plugin

options.title: tsc only
options.pitch: Plain TypeScript compiler, keep a tiny concat step.
cons: No bundling, weak for the single-page dist

options.title: Public domain default, parody opt-in (recommended)
options.pitch: Ship the original/public-domain world as default; parody world as a choice after a lawyer's read.
pros: Review in game review PDF agrees
cons: Parody is the more fun, more viral world
Overrides Bill's earlier call — needs Bill

options.title: Parody default (Bill's current call)
options.pitch: Keep parody as default, get a written legal opinion first.
pros: Strongest hook for fans and streamers

options.title: Both on equal footing
options.pitch: Title screen asks which world; no default.
cons: Still ships parody, same legal exposure

decisions.question: 6. Morale and backstage: one module or two?

options.title: Two modules (recommended)
options.pitch: morale/ = incident ledger + stress (pure numbers). backstage/ = rooms, people, asks, scenes (reads morale).

options.title: One backstage module
options.pitch: Morale lives inside backstage.
cons: Other systems import backstage just for morale

options.title: Morale inside people/
options.pitch: Treat morale as a wrestler attribute area.

decisions.question: 7. Health: one condition value or four body pools?

options.title: Keep one value, add injury location tag (recommended)
options.pitch: Keep w.cond; injuries carry a body part (head/body/arms/legs) for text, scenes and risk.

options.title: Four pools (TEW style)
options.pitch: Head, body, arms, legs each wear down and stack penalties.

options.title: Keep as is
options.pitch: Single condition, no location.
